# Producer Pattern

One project producer coordinates workers, evaluates returns, and accepts the
integrated outcome. A recorder preserves continuity. First candidate.

- [Agent entrypoint](https://producer.metal-sole.com/install.md): installation, verification and explicit update requests; links to canonical protocols.
- [Canonical package](https://github.com/bladnman/producer_pattern/blob/main/pattern/README.md): authoritative installation entrypoint.
- [Update protocol](https://github.com/bladnman/producer_pattern/blob/main/pattern/references/UPDATES.md): preserve project adaptations and private state.
- [Public rationale](https://github.com/bladnman/producer_pattern/blob/main/development/RATIONALE.md): reasons and tradeoffs.

Reading is not adoption. Install/update only on an authorized request. Resolve
published main to an exact reviewed commit; the current package controls.
